## 7. Manager review findings, stated plainly (each verified against the JSON)

(a) INVALID ranking for G/E; F UNMEASURED. **MEASUREMENT**: pooled finals EPE
~1.16–1.17, yet G = 13.7 and E = 7.58 — both exceed total EPE, so their
contribution_px bases cannot be error contributions. G's basis is
sign-only-scaled residual mass (per-subject sign_only_scaled_epe ~13.5–13.9)
and E's is coarse-WTA miss mass (|argmin−GT/8|>1, wta_within_1_candidate_frac
only ~0.20–0.22, wta_hard_argmin_x8_epe ~10.6–10.9). **INFERENCE**: do not rank
by G/E. F's 0.0 comes from an empty edge-distance stratum: every valid pixel
is in [16,inf) with px 0 / epe null in all five nearer bins on all six
subjects — sparse KITTI GT has no ≥3 px edges (Stage C also found this) — so F
is UNMEASURED, not zero; use the disc stratum instead (EPE ~3.46/3.54/3.60 on
~0.33 % of pixels).
(b) R-READOUT ratio limb is a weak design; record as lesson. **MEASUREMENT**:
ratio passes (~31–33x on finals, ~30–33x on bests) but the absolute bimodal
rate among top-decile-error GT<64 pixels is only ~2.6 %
(0.0256/0.0257/0.0261). **INFERENCE**: with top-10 % pixels carrying ~52 % of
EPE (0.5214/0.5201/0.5185), the multimodal population bounds at roughly
0.026 × 0.52 × EPE ≈ 0.0135 × 1.1676 ≈ 0.016 px — far below the 0.1676 gap.
The ratio rule passed while the addressable mass is negligible: weak rule
design, recorded as a lesson.
(c) M1 UNTESTED, not refuted. **MEASUREMENT**: both M1 probes are off-manifold
for the refinement — the GT-index oracle scores +3.5–3.7 px WORSE than the
model (-3.7096/-3.5069/-3.6891), and the A1.2 refined readouts sit ~17 px
(dominant ~17.26/17.35/17.37, top-2 ~17.19/17.28/17.31, top-3 ~17.26/17.35/
17.37). **INFERENCE**: the refinement maps candidate-unit init to pixels
(~×8), so inference-only substitution feeds it inputs far from its training
distribution and cannot evaluate a training-time distribution loss.
**HYPOTHESIS** M1 (distribution supervision) remains open, with (b) bounding
its obvious target population at ~0.016 px.
(d) R-GAP fails; fit/representation limit INFERENCE. **MEASUREMENT**: train-split
pooled EPE ~0.917/0.917/0.925 and GT<64 ~0.862/0.863/0.868 — NOT the contract
(no augmentation, full-res vs 256×512 crops in training). The model does not
fit its own training scenes below ~0.86 on GT<64. **INFERENCE**: with a
train/contract ratio ~0.84 (0.8418/0.8370/0.8425), a sub-1.0 contract result
would need training-set GT<64 EPE near ~0.72 (0.84 × 0.86 ≈ 0.72). Points
toward a fit/representation limit at this footprint — an INFERENCE, not a
measurement of capacity.
(e) Region-level, spatially coherent error. **MEASUREMENT**: signed-error lag-1
autocorrelation ~0.99 h (0.9867/0.9866/0.9861) / ~0.97 v
(0.9709/0.9716/0.9689), horizontal length beyond 32 px on finals seeds 0/2 (32
on the rest); fg (obj_map) EPE ~1.77/1.83/1.83 on 17.36 % of pixels vs bg
~1.04/1.04/1.03. **INFERENCE**: region-level errors, not per-pixel readout
noise.
(f) Negligible global-calibration headroom. **MEASUREMENT**: d5 scale
(seed0: alpha* 1.024 → −0.0088 px; seed1/2: 1.032 → −0.0149/−0.0152 px) and
offset (seed0: beta* 0.13 → −0.0085 px; seed1/2: 0.1675 → −0.0141/−0.0142 px).
**INFERENCE**: global affine calibration cannot close the 0.1676 gap.
(g) Warp-error signal absent. **MEASUREMENT**: Spearman rho 0.030/0.034/0.038
on GT<64 valid pixels — an order of magnitude below the 0.20 bar on 3/3 seeds.
